title: U-Bahnüberführung Seidelstraße im Zuge der Linie C1
main_content: Existing-condition drawing (Bestandsplan) of the U-Bahn overpass at Seidelstraße on line C1. It includes a longitudinal elevation (Ansicht), several cross-sections (Schnitt T-U, L-M, N-O, P-Q, R-S), detail points (Punkt B, C), and a top plan (Draufsicht) with full dimensional annotations and structural details of the bridge structure.

title: U-Bahn Linie U1 (A1) Bhf. Neu-Westend (Nd) - A 55 / Ausgang Nd 1
main_content: Floor plan of the track, tunnel, and ground levels at the Neu-Westend station exit 1, detailing track alignment, stairways, and surrounding structural elements.

title: Rekonstruktion U-Bhf. „Spittelmarkt“ Nebenräume - Ausgang Spittelmarkt, TP: Sanitäre Installation
main_content: Floor plan (Grundriss) of the side rooms and the Spittelmarkt exit of the underground station, showing the sanitary installation layout. The plan depicts the platform areas between track 1 (Gleis 1) and track 2 (Gleis 2), the exit direction, and the routing of technical piping including cold water, gas (town gas), wastewater and insulated lines. A washbasin installation with mirror, shelf and coat rail is indicated, along with drainage pipes and a note to let dirty water in the track area seep away. Notes require coordination with the electrical trade before installation and specify the gas pipe laying below the platform in welded execution.

title: Treppenanlage und Straßeneinteilung an der Haltestelle Alexanderplatz
main_content: Sheet 9 of the plan for the electric elevated and underground railway (Elektrische Hoch- u. Untergrundbahn). It shows the staircase installation and the street division/layout at the Alexanderplatz station stop. The drawing depicts the railway track alignment passing through the area, the surrounding street network and building footprints, the green area of Alexanderplatz with the station structure highlighted in red, and the street and parcel numbering. Scale 1:1000.

title: ZEICHNUNG ZUR UNTERFANGUNG DES HAUSES - BERLINER STR. 1, ECKE HERMANNSTR. 256/57.
main_content: Hand-drawn engineering plans for the underpinning (shoring/bracing) of a building. It includes floor plans for the ground floor (Erdgeschoss), cellar (Kellergrundriss), first and second upper floors (1.+2. Obergeschoss), third upper floor (3. Obergeschoss) and fourth upper floor (4. Obergeschoss), showing the layout of the temporary steel bracing/shoring frames. It also includes an elevation of the bracing (Ansicht der Aussteifung) and a cross-section A-B detailing the vertical shoring posts and beams through the storeys down to the foundation blocks (Klotzlager). Dated Berlin, 29 September 1927, prepared by Asmus Bumann (Tief-, Beton- u. Hochbau, Charlottenburg, Fraunhoferstr. 15).

title: U - BHF. LEINESTR. TOILETTENUMBAU RAUM 16 + 34
main_content: Construction drawings for the renovation (toilet rebuild) of Room 16 (ladies' WC) and Room 34 (gentlemen' WC). The sheet includes floor plans (Grundriss) with demolition and new-build annotations, four cross-sections (Schnitt A-A, B-B, C-C, D-D) showing walls, doors, tiles, sanitary fixtures and ceiling, a notes block (Bemerkungen) describing demolition of old sanitary installations and pipes and the new construction of walls, floor tiles, doors and finishes, and a small location plan (Lageplan) positioning Rooms 16 and 34. All dimensions are to be verified on site.

title: Übersichtsplan Anbau Notausstiegsschacht an vorhandenen Fußgängertunnel
main_content: The plan illustrates the overview and structural details for the extension of an emergency exit shaft connected to an existing pedestrian tunnel. It includes a floor plan, multiple cross-sections (A-A, B-B, C-C, D-D, E-E, F-F), and specific construction details for the reinforced concrete structure, waterproofing, and stairways of the new emergency exit for the U5 subway line.

title: Bahnhof Magdalenenstraße Zwickel I Nebenräume Grundriß u. Längsschnitt
location: Bahnhof Magdalenenstraße, Berlin (Line E 37, km 5,255 – km 5,3)
main_content: Floor plan (Grundriß) and longitudinal section (Schnitt A-A) of the ancillary/side rooms (Nebenräume) of Magdalenenstraße underground station, situated between track 1 (direction Alexanderplatz) and track 2 (direction Honow). The plan lays out five numbered rooms: (1) room for sand and winter equipment, (2) toilets, (3) pump room, (4) room for gas and water connection, and (5) relay room, with overall and internal dimensions, wall and partition details, floor openings and skirting specifications. A legend table lists each room's number, designation, floor area, height and remarks (e.g. painting works, windows to be closed). General notes specify window sizes (480x480, sill 1490 mm), room height (2710 mm) and floor level. The longitudinal section shows the wall elevations, door and window openings (some marked to be closed) and the reference levels: platform top (6420), rail top (7320) and tunnel floor (7820).

title: Böschungssanierung im Bereich Bhf Krumme Lanke von Km 10,3+40-11,1+70,0
location: Bhf Krumme Lanke (Argentinische Allee, Fischerhüttenstr., Wilskistr.)
main_content: Plan for the rehabilitation of the slope/embankment in the area of Krumme Lanke station, between km 10.3+40 and 11.1+70.0. It shows the horizontal layout of the railway track with kilometre markers, bridges, a regional signal box (Reg.-Stellwerk), and surrounding streets and property parcels (A252-A258). Notes indicate that the previous concrete gutter is to be removed and closed with concrete-grass slabs, and that concrete-grass slabs are to be installed according to drawing UBw 16796, with removal of shrubs where necessary.

title: Lage der Leitungen in der Haltestelle Friedrichstrasse.
location: Berlin (Elektr. Hoch- u. Untergrundbahn), Haltestelle Friedrichstrasse
main_content: Plan showing the layout and routing of the utility lines (gas pipe, water pipe, hydrant pipe, drainage pipe and fire-alarm cable) within the Friedrichstrasse underground station. It includes a longitudinal plan of the tunnel with track centerlines, platforms, entrance openings and shafts, plus two detail cross-sections (Schnitt A-B and Schnitt C-D) at 1:50, drawn at scales 1:50 and 1:200, together with a legend explaining the line symbols.

title: U - BHF. KAISERDAMM BAHNHOFSPPLAN
main_content: Floor plan of the Kaiserdamm underground (U-Bahn) station. It shows the station layout with two tracks (Gleis 1 and Gleis 2) and the central platform, the direction of travel indicated toward Ruhleben and toward Zoo, the platform length (approx. 115.0 m), ticket/entry areas, exits labeled Kd I/1, Kd I/2, Kd I/3, Kd I/4, Kd II/1, Kd II/2 and Kd II/4, stairways and escalator shafts, and a numbered legend of rooms including exits, passimeter booths, telephone box, staff room, waste/sand room, equipment room, gas and water meter room, barriers, service rooms for track 1 and 2, transformer room, toilet anteroom and toilets (D and H), electrical room, distribution room, gas meter and equipment room, cassette and first-aid room, service room, goods reception room, escalator rooms, and pump room. Scale 1:200.

title: Brunnen- und Teichbeckenanlage auf dem Nollendorfsplatz. Uebersicht und Grundriss.
main_content: Technical drawing presenting an overview map (1:250) and a detailed floor plan (1:50) of a fountain and pond basin installation. It details the pond structure, water supply infrastructure, a water tower, and a machinery room, showing their placement in relation to the Nollendorfplatz station entrance hall and surrounding streets.
